Mostly just because I have the data and can't edit the python plots in 
Illustrator, will regenerate the cell abundance plots in spatial vs. multiome.

# Env

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(ggpubr)
})

theme_md_classic <- function() {
    theme_classic(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),  # was size 8 in other notebooks?
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}

theme_md_bw <- function() {
    theme_bw(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}
```

## Make cell count tables

```{r}
donor_counts %>% 
    filter(mit_name == "cjNutmeg") %>% 
    select(Cluster_v4, n_cell) %>% 
    setNames(c("cluster", "multiome")) %>% 
    left_join(
        setNames(
            select(spatial_stats, Cluster_v4_name, qc_pass_assigned_cells),
            c("cluster", "spatial")
        ),
        by = "cluster"
    ) %>% 
    left_join(
        tibble::rownames_to_column(
            select(obs, Subcortex_Class_v4, Subcortex_Group_v4), 
            "cluster"
        ),
        by = "cluster"
    ) ->
    df_cl_counts
```

```{r}
print.data.frame(head(df_cl_counts))
```
```{r}
df_grp_counts <- left_join(
    aggregate(multiome ~ Subcortex_Group_v4, df_cl_counts, FUN=sum),
    aggregate(spatial  ~ Subcortex_Group_v4, df_cl_counts, FUN=sum),
    by = "Subcortex_Group_v4"
) %>% 
    left_join(
        unique(select(obs, Subcortex_Class_v4, Subcortex_Group_v4)),
        by = "Subcortex_Group_v4"
    )
```


```{r}
df_cls_counts <- left_join(
    aggregate(multiome ~ Subcortex_Class_v4, df_cl_counts, FUN=sum),
    aggregate(spatial  ~ Subcortex_Class_v4, df_cl_counts, FUN=sum),
    by = "Subcortex_Class_v4"
)
```


## Plot abundance comparisons, neurons & non-neurons

```{r}
df_grp_counts %>% 
    filter(
        Subcortex_Class_v4 != "Nonneuron",
        Subcortex_Class_v4 != "Pineal Gland"
    ) %>% 
    ggplot(
        aes(log10(multiome), log10(spatial))
    ) + 
    geom_point(
        aes(color = Subcortex_Class_v4)
    ) + 
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::math_format(10^.x)) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::math_format(10^.x)) + 
    # geom_smooth(method="lm", color="black") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = palettes$Class) + 
    ggpubr::stat_cor() +
    labs(
        x = "Multiome Cells per Group",
        y = "Spatial Cells per Group",
        title = "Neurons"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic() -> p1
p1
```

```{r}
df_grp_counts %>% 
    filter(
        Subcortex_Class_v4 %in% c("Nonneuron", "Pineal Gland")
    ) %>% 
    ggplot(
        aes(log10(multiome), log10(spatial))
    ) + 
    geom_point(
        aes(color = Subcortex_Group_v4)
    ) + 
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = Subcortex_Group_v4, color = Subcortex_Group_v4),
        size=2, family="ArialMT"
    ) + 
    # geom_smooth(method="lm", color="black", se=FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::math_format(10^.x)) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::math_format(10^.x)) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = palettes$Group) + 
    ggpubr::stat_cor() +
    labs(
        x = "Multiome Cells per Group",
        y = "Spatial Cells per Group",
        title = "Nonneurons"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position="none") -> p2
p2
```

```{r}
p1 + p2
```

```{r}
ggsave(
    file.path(pdir_plots, "cell_abundance_comparisons.pdf"),
    width=120, height=50, units="mm"
)
```
